label: Neostigmine — indirect (anticholinesterase) NMB reversal

extraction.tier_rationale: Indirect anticholinesterase reversal with a hard, well-documented CEILING (cannot reverse deep block) and a depth floor -- the safety content. The numeric ceiling/floor are illustrative, the QUALITATIVE behavior robust.

known_failure_modes.condition: deep neuromuscular block (e.g. PTC 0-1, no TOF response)
known_failure_modes.behavior: neostigmine CANNOT reverse deep block -- the anticholinesterase ceiling: maximal ACh is already present and cannot out-compete a dense block. Attempting it wastes time and risks recurarization; give sugammadex instead.
neostigmine's muscarinic effects (bradycardia, secretions) REQUIRE co-administration of an antimuscarinic (glycopyrrolate/atropine) -- a documented context, not an optional add-on.

extraction.tier_rationale: Indirect-reversal exemplar; the deep-block ceiling and the antimuscarinic requirement are the load-bearing safety facts. Disposition textbook; ceiling/floor illustrative.

notes: Enzyme-inhibition reversal with a CEILING: indirect_inhibition returns the residual block, hard-floored so a deep block is left unreversed (give sugammadex). Never a dose.
